executive_brief: The Enhanced Expense Tracker is a standalone CLI application designed for personal finance management. It utilizes a strict 3-tier architecture (CLI, Service, Repository) to decouple user interaction, business validation, and SQLite persistence. The system enforces rigorous data integrity through atomic transactions and ISO-compliant data patterns.

architectural_constraints: Strict 3-layer isolation: CLI -> Service Layer -> Repository Pattern
Database transactions: mandatory atomic commit/rollback for all write operations
Zero implementation leakage: No SQL in CLI/Service layers; no CLI logic in Repository/Service layers
TDD requirement: Exhaustive pytest suites for all Repository and Service CRUD methods prior to implementation

maturity_assessment: The project specifications are exceptionally robust, demonstrating high structural integrity with all core functional requirements and success criteria clearly mapped. While a minor gap exists regarding a dedicated 'Open Questions' section, this is negligible given the exhaustive detail of the edge cases and architectural constraints. The project is READY for execution.
critical_dependencies: SQLite engine for local data persistence
Pytest framework for mandatory TDD gating
Strict foreign key-like integrity for Expense ID (integer PK) during deletion
Service layer validation gate (100% interception of invalid inputs before Repository access)
